title: Explicit Richards Head-Budget Certificate Production Policy Binding
scope: owner implementation and owner qualification of production policy binding only; no application budget selection and no continuation bootstrap admission

fixed_scientific_semantics.H_budget_validity: explicitly supplied, finite and >0 in the native units required by the selected model; for the Richards binding those units are cm pressure head
fixed_scientific_semantics.generic_acceptance: F-KT09 accepts only available finite nonnegative C_h<=1

architecture_selection.generic_runtime_meaning: opaque model-owned temporal-indicator budget in the selected model's native indicator units; canonical/F-KT transaction code does not interpret its physical units or normalize it
architecture_selection.richards_interpretation: serialized reference Richards backend interprets the supplied native-unit budget as H_budget in cm pressure head and computes C_h=B_inf/H_budget
architecture_selection.reason: This keeps model-specific dimensional semantics outside the generic transaction acceptance core while preserving explicit numerical-configuration ownership and avoiding contamination of physical parameters or committed state.

production_binding_contract.when_history_service_disabled: no model certificate is produced by the Richards backend
production_binding_contract.when_history_unavailable: indicator/certificate remains unavailable; F-KT09 fails closed; current derivative may exist only in the rejected trial clone and cannot bootstrap committed history
production_binding_contract.when_budget_not_supplied: certificate unavailable with explicit diagnostic reason
production_binding_contract.when_budget_supplied_but_invalid: certificate unavailable with explicit diagnostic reason; no clamp, floor, absolute value or default substitution
production_binding_contract.when_B_inf_unavailable_or_invalid: certificate unavailable with explicit diagnostic reason
production_binding_contract.hard_mass_ordering: F-KT09 hard mass gate remains independent and is evaluated before certificate acceptance
production_binding_contract.retry_semantics: existing F-KT09 checkpoint restore and retry_scale semantics are unchanged; a fixed supplied budget is reused across attempts but no claim is made that shorter dt improves C_h
production_binding_contract.commit_semantics: only an accepted transaction can publish physical state and continuation history atomically
production_binding_contract.indicator_companion_cost: unchanged F-SI25 one additional defect tridiagonal solve and zero additional full nonlinear trajectories

frozen_owner_test_matrix.seed_origin: same restricted finite right-sided derivative construction already used by F-KT10/F-VQ31 qualification; qualification-only origin, not arbitrary restart admission

gates.A_SOURCE_AND_SEMANTIC_LOCK: All F-VQ32/F-KT09/F-KT10 source locks and formula/nonclaims remain exact.
gates.B_CONFIG_SEPARATION: Budget is numerical configuration only, absent by default, not in physical parameters, forcing, committed state or transaction policy tolerance.
gates.C_REAL_RICHARDS_CERTIFICATE_ACCEPT: Valid seeded history plus explicit valid budget produces dimensionless C_h and F-KT09 accepts through model-certified route with hard mass intact.
gates.D_THRESHOLD_REJECTION_AND_ROLLBACK: Valid too-small structural probe budget produces temporal rejection and exact physical/history/revision/time rollback.
gates.E_MISSING_INVALID_FAIL_CLOSED: Missing or invalid budget produces certificate-unavailable rejection with no default/clamp/floor.
gates.F_NO_HISTORY_FAIL_CLOSED: No-history origin remains unavailable and cannot self-bootstrap by rejected trials.
gates.G_BOUNDED_RETRY: Existing retry policy is exercised with fixed budget, exact rollback and bounded attempts; no monotonicity assertion or adaptive budget change.
gates.H_COST_AND_MASS: Certificate normalization adds zero nonlinear and zero linear solves; underlying indicator remains zero extra nonlinear plus one defect TRIDAG; hard 1e-12 mass gate unchanged.
gates.I_O0_O2_AND_REGRESSION: Owner matrix O0/O2 machine-readable identity plus F-KT09, F-KT10, F-VQ32-relevant regressions remain green.
gates.J_DIAGNOSTICS: Raw B_inf, budget provenance/validity, C_h, availability/reason and transaction diagnostics are visible without true-error wording.

hard_nonclaims: No numerical H_budget value or universal application tolerance is selected.
No nonlinear true-error upper bound is claimed.
No arbitrary restart or discontinuity history bootstrap is implemented or admitted.
No F-GC02, groundwater coupling or F-PE release follows from owner verification.
No production I/O format or legacy input option is introduced.
next_action: After committing this contract, implement the generic budget carrier and Richards normalization/diagnostics seam without changing F-KT09 transaction acceptance algebra, then add owner tests and CI.
